messages.subject: Make a TABLE read values into shiny
parts:

like:

<table>
<tr>
<td>value1</td>
<td>value2</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td>value4</td>
</tr>

<div id="READ_in_DATA_button" onclick="read_table_values()">Load data into shiny</div>

Thanks and best regards
Nico
